LESSON: SMELL ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL
Topic 3.7: Smell ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Smell ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the body part used in smelling,
2. recognize the pleasant and unpleasant smell in the immediate environment,
3. respond appropriately to the pleasant and unpleasant smell in the surrounding,
4. appreciate the pleasant smell in the immediate environment. Core-Competences to be developed:

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the body part used in smelling,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the body part used in smelling,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. recognize the pleasant and unpleasant smell in the immediate environment,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize the pleasant and unpleasant smell in the immediate environment,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. respond appropriately to the pleasant and unpleasant smell in the surrounding,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to respond appropriately to the pleasant and unpleasant smell in the surrounding,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate the pleasant smell in the immediate environment. Core-Competences to be developed:
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the pleasant smell in the immediate environment. Core-Competences to be developed:. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Smell ENVIRONMENT.
2. Explain Smell ENVIRONMENT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Smell ENVIRONMENT.
4. Show that you can: identify the body part used in smelling,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Smell ENVIRONMENT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Smell ENVIRONMENT important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. identify the body part used in smelling,
2. recognize the pleasant and unpleasant smell in the immediate environment,
3. respond appropriately to the pleasant and unpleasant smell in the surrounding,
4. appreciate the pleasant smell in the immediate environment. Core-Competences to be developed:

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
